context.question: Who will win the 2020 US presidential election?
context.setting: Incumbent Republican President Donald Trump seeks re-election against Democrat Joe Biden; the election is on 3 November 2020. Trump recently tested positive for COVID-19 and has recovered enough to campaign. In Trump's Vedic chart Jupiter sits in the second house aspecting the tenth, where the Sun is placed.

provenance.work: Gulf News, '2020 US elections: Who will be the next US president?', last updated 28 October 2020
